title: Orthrus: Dual -Loop Automated Framework for System -Technology Co - Optimization
evidence_span: II-B defines the MAC-array and customized ASAP7 design space; III coordinates system and technology loops; IV compares against system-only optimization and component ablations.
problem: Cross-layer exploration is expensive and technology choices lack system-level guidance.
method_or_artifact: Bayesian system exploration, critical-cell and Pareto-normal guidance, cell fusion/recharacterization and neural-assisted differential evolution.
workload_or_benchmark: 8x8 systolic MAC array; compressor-tree and carry-propagate-adder alternatives.
hardware_or_process_assumptions: Customized ASAP7; Genus/Innovus implementation with cell characterization and circuit simulation. Not fabricated-silicon measurement.
baselines: System-only optimization with default technology and basic cells
limits: Hypervolume is not application speedup. Iso-power and iso-delay points differ. Figures, normalization and total search-budget fairness remain to be checked. No independent acceptance or cross-workload generalization.
